rules.note: Five-year term, single approved candidate per constituency. The 15th SPA election was held in March 2026, about two years later than the 14th SPA's term implied.
The WPK Rules call for a congress every five years (the 8th Congress article says four). Congresses were held in 2016, 2021 and 2026; party conferences in 2010 and 2012 also elected the leadership.

The first session of each new Supreme People's Assembly elects the chairman of its Standing Committee (formerly President of the Presidium), along with the President of the State Affairs Commission and the Cabinet.

historical.note: 9th Congress of the WPK, 19-25 February 2026, with 5,000 delegates. Kim Jong Un was re-elected General Secretary on the congress's fourth day, which is 22 February 2026 by count; the article cites a Chosun Ilbo report of 23 February 2026.

historical.note: 15th SPA, announced on 4 March 2026 after the 9th WPK Congress. Official results (KCNA, 17 March 2026): turnout 99.99%, 99.93% of votes for the registered candidates, the first reported opposing votes in an SPA election since 1957. Others: social organisations (10) and the allied parties and religious organisations together (6; the Korean Social Democratic Party and the Chondoist Chongu Party are not given separately).
